title: Make the second relay wake admission assertion identify its sequence
outcome: The boot recovery test's pre-outage assertion distinguishes the second message's admitted wake from the first message's retained continuation.
acceptance: Before clearing the process queue in the existing production-shape boot test, a structured assertion requires the queued mailbox source to identify the second message sequence.
The original boot retry, message preservation and receipt ACK assertions remain; relevant focused tests and required review/gate evidence are recorded without phrase pins, sleeps or timeout changes.
